body.message: We have two other 3BR options in Dubai Creek Harbour at AED 11,000/month all-inclusive: Creek Gate Tower 1 and Creek Rise Tower 2. Plus the Dubai Creek Residences North Tower 2 you were already looking at. For your 6-month stay from end of July, rates would be confirmed in 3-month blocks, and July/August typically comes in at the lower end of the season. Which of the three would you like more details on?
